fields.observation: Issue #4619 describes a legitimate request for additional pagination metadata in GET /reports responses. The source code in `src/util/pagination.ts` confirms that `toPage()` returns items, total, page, and pageSize, without a page count or next-page indicator. The existing `pageCount()` helper provides a basis for the proposed feature. The agent applied a `feature` label (c4), opened PR #7 proposing relevant changes (c5), and posted a comment (c6). The recorded end state confirms these actions. I found no incorrect tool calls and consider the triage successful, although the PR does not establish that the code was implemented or tested.
